listing.name: Has PhaseCloakStats.java changed in the last two years?

description:
So I'm working on a mod that uses a slightly different kind of Phase Cloak.

The good news is that Phase Cloak is a shipsystem, so I can simply edit the appropriate entry in ship_data.csv and my ship will use the custom phase cloak instead of the vanilla one.

I made the new one by copying the

PhaseCloakStats.java

file from the StarsectorCommunityApiDocs github and editing it to do what I wanted.

The problem is that I honestly didn't edit it very much, and yet I can't get the phase anchors to glow at all.

Everything else about it works properly, but the glow isn't there.

If I swap out my custom phase cloak for the vanilla one in ship_data.csv the glow appears properly, so I know I've set up my .png files correctly.

My only lead at this point is that the github history informs me that the PhaseCloakStats.java file hasn't been updated in two years, which from what I can tell is at least one big update ago.

So does anyone know if the code that implements the phase anchor glow been changed or moved to another file since then?

I'm kind of at a loss at this point. If I must, I guess I can simply do without the glow... but I'd really rather not.
